keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Di'Shon Bernard (Sheffield Wednesday) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Jamal Lowe (Sheffield Wednesday).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Ashley Maynard-Brewer (Sheffield Wednesday).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Sheffield Wednesday. Connal Trueman replaces Ashley Maynard-Brewer because of an injury.
Yan Valery (Sheffield Wednesday) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half begins Oldham Athletic 0, Sheffield Wednesday 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Liam Palmer (Sheffield Wednesday).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Oldham Athletic 1, Sheffield Wednesday 0. Calum Kavanagh (Oldham Athletic) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Mike Fondop.
Substitution, Oldham Athletic. Oli Hammond replaces Noah Chilvers.
Substitution, Sheffield Wednesday. Max Lowe replaces Liam Palmer.
Substitution, Sheffield Wednesday. Sean Fusire replaces Jordi Liongola.
Substitution, Sheffield Wednesday. Kieran Morrison replaces Ricardo Santos.
Goal! Oldham Athletic 1, Sheffield Wednesday 1. Davis Keillor-Dunn (Sheffield Wednesday) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Sean Fusire.
Callum Slattery (Sheffield Wednesday) is shown the yellow card.
Sean Fusire (Sheffield Wednesday) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Gus Scott-Morriss (Oldham Athletic) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Oldham Athletic. Josh Hawkes replaces Tom Pett.
First Half Extra Time begins Oldham Athletic 1, Sheffield Wednesday 1.
Substitution, Oldham Athletic. Elliott Nevitt replaces Calum Kavanagh.
Manny Monthé (Oldham Athletic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half Extra Time ends, Oldham Athletic 1, Sheffield Wednesday 1.
Substitution, Sheffield Wednesday. Will Grainger replaces Jamal Lowe.
Substitution, Sheffield Wednesday. Ernie Weaver replaces Yan Valery.
Goal! Oldham Athletic 2, Sheffield Wednesday 1. Will Sutton (Oldham Athletic) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal following a set piece situation.
Delay in match (Sheffield Wednesday).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half Extra Time ends, Oldham Athletic 2, Sheffield Wednesday 1.
